みんなと<r=メインシャフト>主縦坑</r>を通って\n地上へ向かう途中――: On our way to the surface with everyone through the <r=Main Shaft>Main Shaft</r>—
俺達はメイズ内に点在する双頭の斧の拠点のひとつで、\n弾薬などの補給がてら短い休: We were taking a short break at one of the Twin-Headed Axe bases scattered throughout the maze to resupply ammo and other provisions.
俺は現在、補給拠点内部で、いろいろ物資を漁っていて――: Right now, I was rummaging through various supplies inside the resupply base—
（今後の戦いは、より過酷なものになる。\n持っていけそうな非常食や、使える物資で: (The battles ahead are only going to get harsher. I just hope there are some emergency rations I can take or usable supplies left...)
……そなた、そんなとこで座り込んで、何をしておる？: ...What are you doing, sitting around in a place like this?
いい非常食や物資がないか、ちょっと漁ってたところだ。\n少しでも機体に貯蔵してお: Just looking around to see if there are any good emergency rations or supplies. It's safer to stock up whatever we can in our mechs, right?
そういうタチアナは、どうした？: What about you, Tatiana? What brings you here?
そなたとふたりきりで、少し話でもしようかと。: I thought I'd come talk to you alone for a bit.
こういう張り詰めた状況下だからこそ、\n少しでも交流を持って親交を深めておきたい: Precisely because we're in such a tense situation, I wanted to take the chance to interact and deepen our bond a little.
皆がいる前じゃ、どうしても話題がイザナミに偏るじゃろう？\n互いの人となりを知る: When everyone's around, the conversation always ends up revolving around Izanami, doesn't it? If we want to truly understand each other as people, I figured it'd be better just the two of us.
（確かに一緒に行動する以上、少しでも人となりは知っておきたい）: (True, since we'll be fighting alongside each other, I should at least try to understand what kind of person she is.)
ちなみに、何かいい物は見つかったかの？: By the way, did you find anything good?
そうだな……\nおっ！ これは掘り出し物じゃないか？: Let's see... Oh! Isn't this quite a find?
美味しそうだ、こいつは当たりだな！\nははっ、双頭の斧の連中も案外いいもん備蓄す: Looks tasty, this is a winner! Haha, the Twin-Headed Axe guys actually stockpile some decent stuff!
ちょ～っと、味見してみるのも悪くないな……！\nタチアナも食べるか？: Doesn't hurt to taste a li～～～ttle bit...! Want some too, Tatiana?
みんなに内緒だぞ？\n特にオルガやコトハはそのあたりうるさそーだし……: Keep it a secret from everyone, okay? Especially Olga and Kotoha, they get pretty annoying about that kind of stuff...
……そなたよ。空元気は元気のうちには入らぬぞ？: ...You. Putting on a false front doesn't count as genuine energy, you know.
…………そう見えたか？: .........Did it look that way to you?
そなたは今、慣れ親しんだ大事な仲間をあんな形で奪われた上、\n圧倒的に不利な戦況: Right now, you've had precious, familiar comrades taken from you in such a manner, and you've been entrusted with the future amidst an overwhelmingly disadvantageous battlefield.
おまけに教導指揮官として、\n儂らの命運まで背負い込もうとしておるじゃろう。: On top of that, as the training commander, you're trying to shoulder our very fates as well.
正直言って、人ひとりが背負うにはあまりにも多すぎるし、重すぎる。: Honestly, it's far too much and far too heavy for a single person to carry.
でも……やらなきゃ、奪われたものは何ひとつ返ってこないし、\n俺を信頼して託して: But... if I don't do this, nothing we lost will ever come back, and they trusted me with this. I have to live up to it.
何より、タチアナ達の命運を背負うのは『指揮官』として当然の責務だ。\n俺はやるべ: Above all, carrying the fate of you and the others is a natural responsibility for a 'Commander'. I'm just doing what needs to be done because I want to.
……と、言っておるが、\nそなた、相当限界が近いのではないか？: ...That's what you say, but aren't you getting dangerously close to your limit?
思っていたより、そなたは不器用じゃな。: You're much clumsier than I thought.
おなごの前では弱音は出せぬか？\nおのこのプライドが邪魔をするのかえ？: Can't show weakness in front of a woman? Is your manly pride getting in the way?
じゃが、その強がりでそなたが壊れれば、儂らも巻き込むぞ？: But if that stubborn bravado of yours breaks you, you'll drag us down with you, you know?
希望と言われ託されたそなたがどうにもならんようになったら、\n儂らはその先どうす: If you, who have been called our hope and entrusted with everything, were to fall apart, what are we supposed to do after that?
良いか？ 今ここにいるのは儂だけじゃ。他には誰も聞いておらんし、\n儂も他人に吹: Listen to me. Right now, it's just the two of us here. No one else is listening, and I'm not mean-spirited enough to go blabbing about this to others.
本当は、自覚しておるんじゃろう？ 自身の限界が近いことを。: Deep down, you're aware of it, aren't you? That you're reaching your limit.
……俺は教導指揮官なんだ。\n弱っている暇なんて……どこにもない。: ...I'm the training commander. I don't have time to be weak... anywhere.
今の段階で限界なんて迎えていたら、\nこれから先戦い抜けるわけがない。: If I hit my limit at a stage like this, there's no way I'll survive the battles to come.
だからこの程度を限界だなんて思うわけには――: That's why I can't afford to think of something like this as my limit—
タチアナは俺が座り込むそばに腰掛けると、\n俺の頭を自身の小さな胸元へそっと抱き: Tatiana sat down beside me where I was squatting, and gently pulled my head against her small chest.
弱さを持つのは、決して悪いことではない。: Having weaknesses is by no means a bad thing.
そう言って、彼女は優しく俺の頭を撫で始める。: With those words, she gently began to stroke my head.
どうしてか、抵抗できなかった。: For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to resist.
教導指揮官として気丈に振る舞おうとするそなたの気持ちも、\nわからんでもないが…: I can understand your desire to act tough as the training commander, but...
このままでは、そなたは限界を迎えるじゃろう。: At this rate, you're going to reach your breaking point.
『この程度を限界だなんて思うわけにはいかない』……\n言い換えれば心の疲弊自体は: "I can't afford to think of this as my limit"... In other words, you're basically admitting that your mind is exhausted, aren't you?
じゃから、たまにはゆっくりするのじゃ。: So, take it easy for once.
儂が、許す。皆そなたにいろいろ求めすぎなのじゃ。\nたまには休んでも誰も責めんよ: I allow it. Everyone expects far too much of you anyway. No one will blame you for resting for a change.
さっきも言ったが、今ここはふたりきりじゃからの。\n儂に好きなだけ、吐き出して良: As I said before, it's just the two of us here now. You can vent to me as much as you like.
ほら、たんと甘えるのじゃ。\n好きなだけ儂の胸の中で『よしよし』してあげるからの: Come on, go ahead and lean on me. I'll pet your head and comfort you in my arms for as long as you want.
まあ、オルガやエレーナに比べて、\nやや柔らかみに欠ける部分は許してほしいのじゃ: Though, compared to Olga and Elena, you'll just have to forgive me for lacking a bit in the softness department.
ふふっ、それはよかったのじゃ。: Fufu, I'm glad to hear that.
（なんかこの構図、ちょっと恥ずかしいな……）: (This situation is a bit embarrassing, honestly...)
でも恥ずかしい気持ちより安らぎが勝ってしまって、\n俺はこの温もりを拒絶できなか: Yet the sense of relief outweighed the embarrassment, and I couldn't bring myself to push away the warmth.
落ち着いてきたかのう？\nどうじゃ？ 吐き出してみて。: Calming down a bit? How is it? Try letting it out.
ああ……軽くなった気がする。: Yeah... I feel a bit lighter.
（俺がやることも、やるべきことも、変わったわけじゃないが……）: (It's not like what I have to do or what I'm supposed to do has changed, but...)
出会って間もない俺に、なぜそこまで優しくしてくれるんだ？: Why are you being so kind to someone you've barely just met?
誰かに優しくするのに、時間なんぞ関係ないじゃろう？\nまあ、元々誰かを支えること: What does time have to do with being kind to someone? Well, I suppose it's mostly because I've always liked supporting others.
頑張り屋なそなたを見ていると、\n誰かが支えてやらんといかんって思ったのじゃ。: Watching you push yourself so hard made me feel like someone had to support you.
どういたしましてなのじゃ。\n……これで少しはあの人に近づけたかのう。: You're very welcome. ...I wonder if this brings me a little closer to her.
今の儂の考え方に、大きな影響を与えたある女性のことじゃ。: A certain woman who had a massive influence on how I think today.
儂がレドフカにいた頃に世話になった初老の女性教諭がいての。\nとても親身に寄り添: When I was in Redovka, there was an elderly female teacher who looked after me. She was deeply empathetic and always so kind to me.
誰かを支えてあげたい……この気持ちはその人から学んだのじゃ。: Wanting to support others... that feeling is something I learned from her.
恩師……みたいな感じか？: Like a mentor... sort of like that?
ちなみに儂の口調も、その人の影響じゃよ。: By the way, my way of speaking is influenced by her as well.
（特徴のある話し方とは思ったが……）: (I figured her speaking pattern was unique, but...)
もしかして、タチアナもその人からよしよししてもらって、\n甘えてたってことか？: Don't tell me Tatiana used to get headpats from her and act spoiled too?
そこでなんで照れるんだ？ 一体どんな甘え方してたんだ……？: Why are you blushing at that? Just how did you act spoiled around her...?
なっ……！？ それは掘り下げ禁止じゃ！\nというか、別に照れてはおらん！: Wha...!? That topic is off-limits! Besides, I am not blushing!
そう言われると、気になるなぁ。: Now that you say that, I'm even more curious.
言わんぞ、絶対言わんからの。\nまったく、少し元気になったからと調子に乗りおって: I won't say it, absolutely not. Honestly, getting all full of yourself just because you recovered a little bit.
これもタチアナのおかげだな。ありがとな。: This is thanks to you too, Tatiana. Thanks.
……はぁ、そう言われると、弱いではないか。: ...Hah, you really know how to get to me when you say things like that.
ここを出たら、ちゃんと漢を見せるのじゃぞ。: Once we leave here, make sure you show us you're a true man.
疲れてしまったとき、弱ってしまったとき、どうしようもないとき、\nまた儂が好きな: Whenever you're tired, whenever you feel weak, whenever you have nowhere else to turn, I'll pamper you as much as you like again.
じゃが、そなたをだらしのない意気地なしにする気はないぞ。\n休んでいても、いつか: However, I have no intention of turning you into some pathetic coward. Even if you rest now, I expect you to straighten your back and stand tall again someday.
タチアナの優しくも厳しい言葉に、俺は気を引き締める。: Tatiana's words, both gentle and stern, helped me pull myself together.
……ま、じゃが、ここを出るまでは、\nまだまだ儂とそなたのふたりの時間じゃ。: ...Well, until we leave this place, it's still just you and me.
どうする？ と問うその瞳に、俺は抗えなかった。: I couldn't resist the gaze in her eyes as they seemed to ask, "What will you do?"
…………じゃあ、もうちょっといいか？: ............Then, can we stay like this just a little longer?
